scenes.caption: Hold close, head and body straight
scenes.narration_line: Hold your baby close, with head and body straight.
safety_points: Support your newborn's bottom, not just head and shoulders.

scenes.caption: Face the breast, nose opposite nipple
scenes.narration_line: Face your baby towards your breast, nose opposite the nipple.

scenes.caption: Touch lips; wait for a wide mouth
scenes.narration_line: Touch their lips with your nipple; wait for a wide-open mouth.

scenes.caption: Bring baby on, lower lip below nipple
scenes.narration_line: Move your baby quickly onto your breast, lower lip below nipple.

scenes.caption: Check chin touches, lip turned out
scenes.narration_line: Look for chin touching the breast and lower lip turned out.
safety_points: Look for more areola above the mouth than below.
